test_selector_all: test the cs.all() selector selects all columns from a polars dataframe
test_selector_by_dtype: test the cs.by_dtype() selector filters dataframe columns by polars or python dtypes
test_selector_by_index: test the cs.by_index() selector selects dataframe columns by positive or negative integer positions
test_selector_by_name: test the cs.by_name() selector selects dataframe columns by exact name with optional require_all flag
test_selector_contains: test the cs.contains() selector matches dataframe column names containing specified substring patterns
